thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — billing-metering anomaly detected (alert id 4945678901). Token heartbeat jitter + delayed window flush in us-west-2 emitters. Possible duplicate counting and delayed usage emits. Severity: high. Paging @raj @emma. https://internal/alerts/4945678901

raj: I'm on it, joining channel now. beginning triage.

emma: here, taking notes. what customers flagged?

sofia: Support FYI — some customers received overage warnings (not charged yet) for automated email. NX, Kappa, and two small customers reported spikes.

raj: initial look — thresholds tripped ~2026-03-17T02:15Z. Token counts doubled across several windows, and we see window flush delays up to ~7 minutes. Emitter group metering-emitter-v2-astral showing restart storm.

ben: logs show repeated OOM/CrashLoop for emitter pods then replays from emitter backoff, which is causing duplicate events when replayed into the aggregator. suspect interleaving heartbeats + dedupe gap.

raj: isolating affected pods and pausing new consumer reads to stop further duplicates. prepping mitigation steps.

ben: commands I'm running now:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n billing -l app=metering-emitter -o wide
kubectl logs -n billing metering-emitter-v2-astral-2 --since=15m | grep '\bheartbeat\b'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/metering-emitter -n billing\```

emma: good — while you restart, can we throttle new ingestion into the billing pipeline (read-only gate) so overage flags stop being generated until we reconcile?

raj: toggled the pipeline to read-only gate for emulator consumers at 02:23Z. muting upstream overage alerting group for affected accounts now.

sofia: I'm going to mute customer-facing overage emails for the three affected tiers and inform CS to not auto-escalate. drafting a short message to NX/Kappa now.

linda: drafting message for CS: "We detected transient usage-reporting anomalies causing overage warnings. No charges will be applied while we reconcile. We'll provide an update within 6 hours." Will post to the customers once we confirm mitigation.

ben: restart completed at 02:29Z. pod count stabilized, crashloops stopped. Replay rate dropped ~85% but backlog still draining — estimate ~120k tokens/min remaining.

raj: starting de-dupe filter to ignore events with seq <= last_processed_seq for each emitter to avoid double counting as backlog flushes. Pushed small patch to aggregator.

emma: can you share the reconciliation query so finance can see impacted accounts?

raj: running quick reconciliation query against usage_events (last hour):
```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as token_sum, COUNT(*) as events
FROM usage_events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-17T02:00:00Z' AND ts <= '2026-03-17T03:00:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY token_sum DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

sofia: support note: 12 premium customers saw warnings, none reported actual billing card charges. We'll hold billing actions until postmortem reconcile. tagging @legal for approved customer wording.

ben: mitigation checklist items for post-incident: increase liveness memory thresholds, add tighter backoff on emitter replay, add guard in aggregator to detect interleaved heartbeats. I'll open PRs now.

incident-bot: Incident update — mitigation in progress, severity -> degraded. Next update scheduled in 15 minutes.

raj: handing off to night oncall @emma at 03:30Z — I'm stepping off for the handover. runbook: https://internal/runbooks/metering-heartbeat-stretch. leaving notes: patch applied, pipeline read-only set, overage alerts muted, support notified. follow-up: postmortem + customer reconciliation by EOD.

emma: taking over. I'll monitor backlog drain and confirm customer messages. please add any outstanding TODOs here before you go. :thumbsup:

raj: nothing else from me, thanks.

sofia: I'll coordinate with CS/legal for the customer note and post an update in #support-outreach after confirmation.

linda: posting draft to #support-outreach and waiting for legal sign-off.

emma: confirmed aggregator de-dupe in place. backlog trending down, expected to finish draining in ~40 minutes. will escalate if we see replays again.

incident-bot: Final automated note for thread: incident state: mitigated->degraded->monitoring. record id 4945678901.
